description: React SPA frontend with booking form, real-time status monitoring, endpoint display, IP whitelist management, notification configuration, and booking history. Simple functional UI with basic auth login.
steps: Create platform/frontend/ with package.json for React 18 + TypeScript + Vite build tool. Dependencies: react, react-dom, @types/react, @types/react-dom, typescript, vite, @vitejs/plugin-react, antd (for UI components).
Create platform/frontend/src/main.tsx: React app entry point with BrowserRouter

Create platform/frontend/src/App.tsx: Main app layout with sidebar navigation (Bookings, Monitoring, History, Settings) and basic auth login modal on first load. Store credentials in sessionStorage for API calls.

Create platform/frontend/src/api/client.ts: API client that makes fetch calls to the API Gateway URL with Basic Auth header. Configure base URL from environment variable VITE_API_URL. Methods: createBooking, listBookings, getBooking, cancelBooking, updateWhitelist, getDeploymentPlans, getInstances, updateNotificationConfig.

Create platform/frontend/src/pages/BookingPage.tsx: (a) Dropdown to select deployment plan (fetched from GET /deployments, showing instance type + topology description), (b) Submit button that calls POST /bookings, (c) Conflict dialog: when API returns 409, show modal with 'An instance of this type is already running with plan X. Override and redeploy?' with Confirm/Cancel buttons. Confirm sends POST with confirmOverride=true.

Create platform/frontend/src/pages/MonitoringPage.tsx: (a) List of active bookings with status badges (polling=yellow spinning, launching=blue, deploying=orange, ready=green, failed=red), (b) For 'ready' bookings: show OpenAI-compatible endpoint URL (http://<ip>:30080/v1), copy button, (c) IP whitelist editor: text area for IPs (one per line) with Save button calling PUT /bookings/{id}/whitelist, (d) Auto-refresh every 10 seconds.

Create platform/frontend/src/pages/HistoryPage.tsx: Table of all bookings (current + past) with columns: ID, Instance Type, Plan, Status, Created, Duration, Region. Sort by created desc. Status filter dropdown.

Create platform/frontend/src/pages/SettingsPage.tsx: (a) Email notification: input for email address, (b) Feishu webhook: input for webhook URL with test button, (c) Save button calling PUT /notifications.
Create platform/frontend/vite.config.ts with React plugin and proxy config for local dev
Create platform/frontend/index.html as Vite entry point
Add build script in platform/frontend/package.json: 'build' outputs to dist/ which CDK deploys to S3
Update CDK stack to include BucketDeployment that deploys frontend/dist/ to the S3 bucket after build
acceptance_criteria: Running 'cd platform/frontend && npm install && npm run build' produces dist/ with index.html
All TypeScript files compile without errors
The booking form shows available deployment plans with instance type descriptions
Conflict detection dialog appears on 409 response
Monitoring page shows endpoint URL for ready bookings
IP whitelist editor allows managing allowed IPs
Settings page allows configuring email and Feishu webhook
CDK synth still succeeds with the frontend deployment added
verification: cd platform/frontend && npm install && npm run build
cd platform && npm run build && npx cdk synth --quiet
